paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Livai: Berakhot 55b according to Ein Yaakov; the ordinary text has simply Rav Huna.
Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi is called bar Livai; see his entry. Rabbah bar Livai, Pesachim 40b.

notes.text: Ein Yaakov is the cited reading for Huna bar Livai; the ordinary reading lacks the patronym. The list retains Yehoshua ben Levi’s separate use of bar Livai.

The consulted Berakhot 27b directly names Rav Dimi bar Livai. The exact Ein Yaakov reading for Huna bar Livai was not independently inspected here; the collective list does not establish one shared father for all its names.
